xtrm-y9i.description:
Handoff for session ending 2026-06-10 (continuing into 2026-06-11).

**SSOT report:** `.xtrm/reports/2026-06-10-ca7cdad.md`

Read the report first — it has the full summary, problems (including the specialist-runtime zero-token issue that triggered manual orchestrator authority), open issues with context, and the ordered next-priority list. This bead is the live pointer into the board.

**Session in one sentence:** shipped the xtrm-2m3 epic end-to-end (new `packages/mcpq/` CLI live-verified against mercury_platform sidecars), tightened xtrm main branch protection, scaffolded umbrella + per-package CHANGELOG, filed verify-in-infra (closed overnight by user) and SSH-signing followups.

**Suggested next priorities (from report §Suggested Next Priority):**
1. **Land mercury-infra PR #76 → mcpq integration** — one-click `gh pr merge --squash 76` from the user closes the loop on xtrm-2m3 outside of xtrm. No xtrm-side bead — external action.
2. **`xtrm-8fo`** SSH commit signing — 2-minute setup to harden the last gap in xtrm main branch protection. Recipe fully specified in the bead.
3. **Merge `ca7cdad` (overnight) work to a formal PR** — currently FF'd into main, but if new branch-protection rules need a recorded PR, a `chore:` PR will land it formally. No bead — process action.
4. **Stale `shlex.quote` comment in `packages/mcpq/src/mcpq/transport.py:172`** — reviewer's only non-blocking finding from Phase A. One-line edit. No bead — cleanup.

Note: priorities 1, 3, 4 don't have associated beads — they're external actions or trivial cleanup the next session can do directly from this report.
xtrm-y9i.title: Session handoff 2026-06-10: pick up next priorities

external_relations.target_title: Enable SSH commit signing + required_signatures on xtrm main
